content: {"praised":["Nancy Meyers' direction brings fresh, witty comedy to the screen.","Meryl Streep delivers nuanced, mature performance as a divorced businesswoman.","Script balances humor with heartfelt romance and relatable family dynamics.","Film offers a light, enjoyable romantic comedy tone.","Visuals and music support the warm, contemporary setting."],"criticized":["Story feels confusing, not clearly a romantic comedy.","Plot is overly sad and tragic, lacking humor.","Characters act frivolously, lacking depth and seriousness.","Dialogue feels forced, with constant giggling.","Themes of infidelity presented as ego boost, offensive."]}
